response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS overall_avg FROM patient_averages), kept AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, o.overall_avg FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS mean_kept_hgb FROM kept) SELECT k.ID, k.avg_hgb, k.avg_hgb - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, k.avg_hgb - m.mean_kept_hgb AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10;
